body.statement: For every fixed law in \(\mathcal M_q^{\mathrm{FOBI}}\), whose structural errors satisfy \(0<\operatorname{Var}(e_i)<\infty\) for every \(i\in[q]\), the plug-in covariance estimator obeys \(\widehat V_m\to_{\Pr}V_{\mathrm{FOBI}}\), and the matrix-valued symmetrized set satisfies \(\liminf_{m\to\infty}\Pr\{N_{\mathrm{stab}}(W)\in C_m^N\}\geq1-\alpha\). Moreover, \(d_{\mathrm H,F}(K_m,\mathcal O_U(W))=O_{\Pr}(m^{-1/2})\) in the normalized-row Frobenius topology, equivalently the underlying estimator contracts in the quotient metric \(d_{\mathrm{orb}}\). Both assertions are pointwise in the fixed law; no uniform graph-support, shrinking-kurtosis-gap, zero-normalization-boundary, or unit-circle-boundary guarantee is made.
body.justification: Region-first inversion respects ICA indeterminacy and avoids differentiating an integer-valued functional.
body.gap: Miettinen et al. stop at a labelled FOBI matrix limit, while generic set-inversion work does not handle the monomial ICA orbit and Schur-normalization discontinuities.
body.consumer: Applied cyclic-LiNG analyses can report count uncertainty without claiming uniform support recovery or selecting an arbitrary ICA labeling.
